title: The Stag Trial
text: A stag with antlers like a winter tree steps out of the mist, white as bone, its eyes burning. It offers a race to whoever thinks they can win it. It does not say what happens to whoever loses.

options.label: The fastest races the white stag, and does not ask what losing costs.

outcomes.text: Neck and neck, and the stag bows, and something of its speed stays with them.
The stag wins, and leaves them in a thicket, bleeding from the legs.

options.label: Bow to the stag, and decline its race.

outcomes.text: It leads you a stretch through the mist.

options.label: The Leader shoots it. A white hide is worth a purse.

outcomes.text: The forest goes very quiet, and stays quiet.
